definitions.explanation: Preserving food or other materials by keeping them at freezing temperatures. A common household technique and also used industrially and in medicine.

examples.english: I freeze leftover rice for storage.

examples.english: If you freeze pre-made side dishes, you can prepare meals quickly even on busy days.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in everyday cooking and meal preparation contexts. Japanese cooking blogs and TV shows frequently discuss {冷凍保存|れいとうほぞん} techniques for rice, bread, vegetables, and prepared dishes. Also used in medical contexts for tissue and cell preservation.
